articles.title: Kraken parent Payward and its clients buy AAVE tokens in DeFi investment push
articles.snippet: The investment follows talks first reported by CoinDesk in June that included a proposed equity stake in Aave Group.

articles.title: XRP Ledger fixes a disclosed bug that could have led to the creation of new tokens
articles.snippet: The fix went live Wednesday after validator support reset the activation clock in October. XRP itself was unaffected.

articles.title: Thailand to block Bitget in December over unlicensed crypto trading
articles.snippet: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, with access to its website and app set to be blocked from Dec. 5.

articles.title: Binance, Polymarket seek Polygon hard fork to recover $6.8M in stolen crypto
articles.snippet: Polygon block producers have already frozen the stolen tokens, but a proposed hard fork would allow the funds to be recovered and returned to their owners.

articles.title: Trump-linked tokens lead crypto losses after Democrats sweep in the US midterms
articles.snippet: The official Trump and World Liberty Financial tokens were the two biggest losers among the top 100 cryptocurrencies on Wednesday, even as Bitcoin and Ether rallied.
